review_locator: PMCID:PMC3070580, Functional Contributions of N- and O-Glycans to L-Selectin Ligands; PMCID:PMC2700822, Endoglycan vascular-selectin ligand study
primary_title: Endomucin, a sialomucin expressed in high endothelial venules, supports L-selectin-mediated rolling
decision_basis: The reviews identify endomucin as a PNAd sialomucin and the cited primary study demonstrates L-selectin-reactive glycoforms plus L-selectin-dependent rolling under flow when the required glycosylation enzymes are co-expressed.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HEV/endothelial splice and glycoform context, C2GnT/FucTVII/LSST-dependent modification, and flow/shear boundary; no endomucin intracellular signaling or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Sulphation requirement for GlyCAM-1, an endothelial ligand for L-selectin; Affinity and kinetic analysis of L-selectin binding to GlyCAM-1; GlyCAM-1, a physiologic ligand for L-selectin, activates beta 2 integrins on naive peripheral lymphocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify GlyCAM-1 as a secreted PNAd ligand and the cited primary studies demonstrate sulfation-dependent purified L-selectin binding, quantitative monomeric binding, and L-selectin-linked beta2-integrin activation in naive lymphocytes.
limitations_preserved: Preserve secreted mouse GlyCAM1, sulfated/sialylated O-glycan dependence, multivalent versus monomeric binding, and lymphocyte integrin-activation context; no GlyCAM1 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3070580, Functional Contributions of N- and O-Glycans to L-Selectin Ligands; PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin
primary_title: Nepmucin, a novel HEV sialomucin, mediates L-selectin-dependent lymphocyte rolling and promotes lymphocyte adhesion under flow
decision_basis: The reviews identify nepmucin as an HEV sialomucin and the cited primary study demonstrates L-selectin-reactive nepmucin glycoforms, mucin-domain-dependent lymphocyte rolling, and additional shear-resistant lymphocyte binding through its Ig domain.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mouse HEV nepmucin, mucin-domain glycosylation and Ig-domain adhesion dual function, and flow/shear context; no nepmucin intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3195965, CD44 and HCELL review; PMCID:PMC6711759, Selectins in cancer immunity
primary_title: Targeting Underglycosylated MUC1 for the Selective Capture of Highly Metastatic Breast Cancer Cells Under Flow; Three to Tango: MUC1 as a Ligand for Both E-Selectin and ICAM-1 in the Breast Cancer Metastatic Cascade
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary flow, blocking, and knockdown studies showing sialyl-Lewis-X-bearing underglycosylated MUC1 supports E-selectin-dependent rolling of metastatic breast-cancer cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve underglycosylated/sialyl-Lewis-X-bearing MUC1 glycoform, metastatic breast-cancer model, and E-selectin rolling versus ICAM-1 firm-adhesion sequence; no MUC1 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3195965, CD44 and HCELL review; PMCID:PMC6711759, Selectins in cancer immunity
primary_title: Targeting Underglycosylated MUC1 for the Selective Capture of Highly Metastatic Breast Cancer Cells Under Flow
decision_basis: The reviews cite the primary flow study showing sialyl-Lewis-X-bearing underglycosylated MUC1 supports P-selectin-dependent tumor-cell tethering, distinct from E-selectin-supported rolling and absent L-selectin adhesion in the tested breast-cancer model.
limitations_preserved: Preserve underglycosylated/sialyl-Lewis-X-bearing MUC1 glycoform and P-selectin tethering-only behavior in the tested tumor-cell flow model; no MUC1 intracellular relay or SCI inference.
